knownProductBehaviour.where: Records > Data Room sources of every project, in any client workspace (each sponsor's own workspace included), from the first time anyone reads that project's data room
knownProductBehaviour.trigger: the first page of a project's data room, GET /api/c2c/projects/:id/sources at offset 0: opening Records > Data Room sources, the editor's sources rail, or a seed pack's read. This pack makes that read on one project, stage h (the shared agency-letter step and its read-back); the capture is the same on every project whoever reads it first.
knownProductBehaviour.cause: server/services/clinical-regulatory-evidence/data-room-search.ts prepareSourceScope calls record-source.ts syncQualityProjectSources, which snapshots into the project's data room what server/services/qms/project-evidence-queries.ts returns: suppliers, internal audits and management reviews for the whole organisation; change controls with no program; GMP deviations and quality plans with no client workspace; and their record relationships.
knownProductBehaviour.ownWorkspace: A sponsor's own client workspace does not stop it. On the local database (2026-11-09) every portfolio project in its sponsor's workspace holds the same 21 records from other packs (Lumen suppliers, internal audits, management reviews and GMP deviations; change controls for C2C-101 and MDX NP-100 with no program; four record relationships) as the archived projects in the organisation's own workspace (docs/evidence/DEMO/portfolio/sponsor-workspaces/README.md).
knownProductBehaviour.action: Reported to the coordinator and the product owner, who rule on the capture's scope in project-evidence-queries.ts. The pack changes nothing to mask it; observedThisRun is stage h's data room as this run read it back.
